raw_text: Greetings, Oleg. ☀️🌻🌱 It is a privilege to guide you through the celestial currents of this Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Your natal chart is anchored by a precise Aquarius Ascendant at 1°32', and today’s transit of the Moon through Scorpio activates your 10th house of career and professional status, aligning powerfully with your Midheaven at 28°46' Scorpio. As the day is governed by Mars, the 1st lunar day of this New Moon phase emphasizes fresh initiatives, raw courage, and the strategic deployment of your personal energy. 🪐 Planetary Influences Today Today’s transit of the Moon through Scorpio forms an intense sextile to your natal placement, heightening your intuition regarding professional power dynamics. With Mars acting as the planetary ruler of the day, your Aquarius Ascendant receives a surge of drive, urging you to break through stagnant barriers in your 10th house of career. This is a day where your internal resolve meets external opportunity, provided you channel your focus with the precision of a seasoned strategist. 💼 Work, Business & Finance The alignment of the Moon in your 10th house suggests this is an ideal time for high-stakes negotiations and auditing complex financial structures. Leverage the influence of Mars to initiate bold business moves, focusing on decisive actions between 09:15 and 11:30, or during the secondary power window of 14:45 and 16:20. Avoid impulsive spending, as the 1st lunar day favors planning and setting long-term intentions rather than immediate, reactive transactions. ❤️ Personal Relationships & Communication The lunar energy in Scorpio demands authenticity and depth in your interactions, making this a period to shed superficial social layers in favor of meaningful, transformative dialogue. In your business partnerships, your natural Gemini curiosity combined with the intensity of your Scorpio Midheaven will allow you to read between the lines during critical discussions. Maintain emotional boundaries to ensure that your professional objectives remain clear and unclouded by personal sentiment. 🌿 Health & Vitality Your physical vitality is linked to the Martian energy of the day, which requires active movement to prevent potential stagnation or tension. Prioritize intense physical activity or a brisk walk in the morning to stabilize your energy levels, and ensure you dedicate time in the evening to a water-based ritual—such as a warm bath or a meditative shower—to ground the intense Scorpio lunar influence. 💡 Wise Advice for Today Since this is the 1st lunar day, your greatest power lies in the clarity of your mental focus; do not rush into execution until your strategy is fully formed. If you feel the pressure of the Martian influence causing impatience, practice the grounding technique of intentional breathing or review your financial documents to regain a sense of control and order. ✨ Today's Blessing May your intentions today be as sharp and clear as the morning sun, guiding you toward the success you have meticulously prepared for. Trust in the quiet strength of your own wisdom, for you possess all the internal resources necessary to turn this day into a foundation for your future prosperity.
